# Everything after a -- is handed to go test as written, so a project can run
# its mutation testing the way it runs its tests: build tags, -race, -shuffle,
# whatever the suite needs.
#
# Three flags are refused rather than fought over. muxt sets each of them
# itself, and losing one does not degrade the run, it breaks it: -overlay is
# how a mutant reaches the build at all, -json is how the tests that caught it
# are read back, and -run has to go through muxt's own flag or the state file
# records a selection the verdicts were not reached under.

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -- -tags=extra
cmp stdout want.txt

# go list is asked with the same tags, so a test that only exists under one is
# in the suite record and editing it invalidates. Without this it would be
# invisible, and its verdicts would never be retried.
grep '"TestTagged"' testdata/template-mutations.json

# Without the tag it is not part of the suite, and not recorded.
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 --state other.json
! grep '"TestTagged"' other.json

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -- -overlay=/tmp/mine.json
stderr 'go test flag -overlay cannot be passed through: muxt uses -overlay to deliver each mutant'

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -- -json
stderr 'go test flag -json cannot be passed through'

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -- -run TestGreet
stderr 'go test flag -run cannot be passed through: use muxt'

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name string
}

func Greet(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreet(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Greet(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, World!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- tagged_test.go --
//go:build extra

package server

import "testing"

// TestTagged only exists under -tags=extra. The suite record is read with
// the same tags, so editing it invalidates rather than going unnoticed.
func TestTagged(t *testing.T) {
	if got := "Hello, World!"; got == "" {
		t.Error("unreachable")
	}
}
-- want.txt --
1 mutant across 1 template (complexity 1, seed 1)
baseline ok

1 mutant, 1 killed, 0 missed, 0 skipped
